app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/ui/overlay/OcrOverlayService.kt

ЗАДАЧА: найти всё, что не скомпилируется или упадёт в рантайме. Проверь по пунктам:

1. ИМПОРТЫ: каждый ли импорт в OcrOverlayService.kt существует и используется; нет ли НЕИСПОЛЬЗУЕМЫХ импортов (ktlint/ detekt могут ругаться); нет ли отсутствующих импортов для используемых символов. Сверь список импортов с фактическим использованием (например, android.widget.TextView, android.view.MotionEvent, android.view.Gravity, android.view.View, android.view.ViewGroup, android.os.Looper, android.os.Bundle, androidx.compose.*).
2. СИГНАТУРЫ OcrControlMenu.kt: вызовы OcrControlMenuCard, OcrControlFab, OcrMenuActionButton, OcrMenuAction, OcrMenuRow в сервисе должны точно совпадать с объявлениями (имена параметров, порядок дефолтов, типы). Проверь, что все переданные параметры существуют.
3. COMPOSE В СЕРВИСЕ: корректно ли создание ComposeView, setViewTreeLifecycleOwner/setViewTreeSavedStateRegistryOwner/setViewTreeViewModelStoreOwner, setComposeContent. Проверь по исходникам androidx (найди их в gradle-кэше, если доступны: ~/.gradle/caches/modules-2/files-2.1/androidx.lifecycle, androidx.savedstate — распакуй/найди class-файлы или sources), что эти функции существуют с такими сигнатурами и что они extension-функции на View. Проверь, что SavedStateRegistry.create(owner) вызывается ДО перевода lifecycle в STARTED (иначе исключение), и что порядок инициализации свойств верный.
4. СОСТОЯНИЕ: mutableStateOf-поля используются корректно; нет обращений к удалённым полям (bubbleText, contentView, floatButton, sttButton, regionButton, regionRowLabel, readRowLabel, readButton, isSpeaking, isCollapsed, expandedW).
5. ФУНКЦИИ: все ли вызываемые методы определены (toggleFrameReading, dragPanelBy, settlePanel, savePanelPosition, setWindowFocusable, makeFocusable, onPanelMeasured, maxWindowHeightPx, maxPanelCardHeight, panelStatus, menuRows, panelInput, collapseNow, expandNow, updatePanelVisibility, ownActivityWatcher, panelLifecycleOwner/panelSavedStateOwner/panelViewModelOwner). Все ли функции, которые вызываются ИЗ сервиса, но объявлены вне (requestGestureService, OcrCaptureActivity.request, OcrOverlayService-использование) имеют нужные сигнатуры.
6. ТИПЫ: Int.dp, Arrangement.spacedBy(Dp), Arrangement.Bottom/Center, Alignment.End, Modifier.onSizeChanged, Modifier.onFocusChanged, Offset.roundToInt, WindowManager.LayoutParams-поля, Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks (все 7 методов), Lifecycle.State, ViewTreeSavedStateRegistryOwner.set и т.п.
7. ЛОГИКА: не сломано ли поведение — чтение рамки, буфер обмена, STT, селектор области, рамка, сворачивание/разворачивание, snapToCorner, clampToScreen, makeFocusable. Обрати внимание на onDestroy (регистрация/снятие колбэков, уничтожение композиции).
8. ЛЮБЫЕ ДРУГИЕ ошибки компиляции: типы-несовместимости, неразрешённые ссылки, private-функции вне класса, кавычки/экранирование в строках с эмодзи/глифами.

ФОРМАТ ОТВЕТА: нумерованный список найденных проблем в порядке критичности. Для каждой: файл+строка, что не так, и точная правка (как должно быть). Если всё в порядке — так и напиши явно. НЕ вноси правки в файлы сам, только отчёт. Не выдумывай проблемы: если не уверен — помечай как «требует проверки».

394:                 if (text.isNotBlank()) {
395:                     expandNow()
396:                     speakText(text)
397:                 }
398:             }
399:             ACTION_STT_START -> toggleStt(force = true)
400:             ACTION_STT_STOP -> toggleStt(force = false)
401:             ACTION_SELECT_REGION -> {
402:                 expandNow()
403:                 openSelector()
404:             }
405:             ACTION_REFRESH -> {
406:                 applyClipboardWatch()
407:                 applyFrame()
408:             }
409:             ACTION_START_READING -> {
410:                 val code = intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_RESULT_CODE, 0)
411:                 val data: Intent? = intent.getParcelableExtra(EXTRA_RESULT_DATA)
412:                 if (data == null) {
413:                     toast("Разрешение на захват не получено")
414:                 } else {
415:                     val projection = runCatching {
416:                         val mpm = getSystemService(Context.MEDIA_PROJECTION_SERVICE)
417:                             as android.media.projection.MediaProjectionManager
418:                         mpm.getMediaProjection(code, data)
419:                     }.getOrNull()
420:                     if (projection == null) {
421:                         toast("Не удалось начать захват экрана")
422:                     } else {
423:                         startReading(projection)
424:                     }
425:                 }
426:             }
427:         }
428:         applyClipboardWatch()
429:         applyFrame()
430:         // Панель не должна висеть поверх наших собственных настроек и
431:         // читалки: иначе полупрозрачная панель лежала на экране поверх текста.
432:         updatePanelVisibility()
433:         return START_STICKY
434:     }

462:     /**
463:      * Прячет панель, пока на экране само приложение.
464:      *
465:      * Сверху окна с разрешением SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW нельзя спрятать наше
466:      * собственное окно, но можно не рисовать панель поверх него: иначе
467:      * настройки оверлея открывались поверх самих себя.
468:      *
469:      * Раньше «мы на переднем плане» определялось через UsageStatsManager, и
470:      * без разрешения «usage access» (оно в приложение не запрашивается)
471:      * проверка всегда возвращала false — панель так и висела поверх наших
472:      * же настроек. Теперь это обычные колбэки жизненного цикла Activity:
473:      * ничего разрешать не нужно и ошибки быть не может.
474:      */
475:     private var ownActivitiesResumed = 0
476: 
477:     private val ownActivityWatcher = object : Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks {
478:         override fun onActivityResumed(activity: Activity) {
479:             if (activity.packageName != packageName) return
480:             ownActivitiesResumed++
481:             updatePanelVisibility()
482:         }
483: 
484:         override fun onActivityPaused(activity: Activity) {
485:             if (activity.packageName != packageName) return
486:             ownActivitiesResumed = (ownActivitiesResumed - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)
487:             updatePanelVisibility()
488:         }
489: 
490:         override fun onActivityCreated(activity: Activity, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) = Unit
491:         override fun onActivityStarted(activity: Activity) = Unit
492:         override fun onActivityStopped(activity: Activity) = Unit
493:         override fun onActivitySaveInstanceState(activity: Activity, outState: Bundle) = Unit
494:         override fun onActivityDestroyed(activity: Activity) = Unit
495:     }
496: 
497:     private fun updatePanelVisibility() {
498:         val view = root ?: return
499:         val wanted = if (ownActivitiesResumed > 0) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
500:         if (view.visibility != wanted) view.visibility = wanted
501:     }

504:     private fun ensureForeground() {
505:         val nm = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
506:         if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
507:             nm.createNotificationChannel(
508:                 NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID, "OCR-оверлей", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW),
509:             )
510:         }
511:         val launch = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
512:         val contentIntent = launch?.let {
513:             PendingIntent.getActivity(
514:                 this,
515:                 0,
516:                 it,
517:                 PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE or PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT,
518:             )
519:         }
520:         val builder = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
521:             Notification.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
522:         } else {
523:             @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
524:             Notification.Builder(this)
525:         }
526:         val b = builder
527:             .setContentTitle("OCR-кнопка")
528:             .setContentText("Плавающая кнопка поверх приложений")
529:             .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_view)
530:             .setOngoing(true)
531:         if (contentIntent != null) b.setContentIntent(contentIntent)
532:         if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
533:             // Тип mediaProjection обязателен: без него на Android 14+ система
534:             // не отдаст MediaProjection и захват рамки не запустится.
535:             startForeground(
536:                 NOTIF_ID,
537:                 b.build(),
538:                 ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK or
539:                     ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MEDIA_PROJECTION,
540:             )
541:         } else {
542:             startForeground(NOTIF_ID, b.build())
543:         }
544:     }

697:     private fun parseRegion(): Region? {
698:         val parts = prefs.overlayFixedRegion().get().split(',').mapNotNull { it.toFloatOrNull() }

701:         if (!(l in 0f..1f && t in 0f..1f && r in 0f..1f && b in 0f..1f && l < r && t < b)) return null
702:         return Region(l, t, r, b)

735:     /** Полноэкранный селектор: потяните пальцем прямоугольник области. */
736:     private fun openSelector() {
737:         if (selectorRoot != null) return
738:         val dm = resources.displayMetrics
739:         val layout = FrameLayout(this)
740:         layout.setBackgroundColor(0x88000000.toInt())
741:         val draw = RegionDrawView(this)
742:         layout.addView(draw, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT))
743:         selectorDraw = draw
744: 
745:         val hint = TextView(this)
746:         hint.text = "Выделите область пальцем • тап — отмена"
747:         hint.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF.toInt())
748:         hint.textSize = 14f
749:         hint.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
750:         hint.setPadding(0, dp(48f), 0, 0)
751:         layout.addView(hint, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, Gravity.TOP))
752: 
753:         var downX = 0f
754:         var downY = 0f
755:         var moved = false
756:         layout.setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
757:             when (event.actionMasked) {
758:                 MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
759:                     downX = event.rawX
760:                     downY = event.rawY
761:                     moved = false
762:                     draw.setRect(downX, downY, downX, downY)
763:                     true
764:                 }
765:                 MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
766:                     moved = true
767:                     draw.setRect(downX, downY, event.rawX, event.rawY)
768:                     true
769:                 }
770:                 MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
771:                     if (!moved) {
772:                         closeSelector()
773:                     } else {
774:                         val r = draw.normalized(dm.widthPixels, dm.heightPixels)
775:                         if (r != null) {
776:                             prefs.overlayFixedRegion().set("${r.l},${r.t},${r.r},${r.b}")
777:                             prefs.overlayRegionMode().set("fixed")
778:                             updateRegionButton()
779:                             toast("Область зафиксирована")
780:                         }
781:                         closeSelector()
782:                         applyFrame()
783:                     }
784:                     true
785:                 }
786:                 else -> false
787:             }
788:         }
789: 
790:         val windowType = overlayType()
791:         val p = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
792:             ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
793:             ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
794:             windowType,
795:             WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
796:                 WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN,
797:             PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT,
798:         )
799:         selectorRoot = layout
800:         runCatching { wm.addView(layout, p) }.onFailure {
801:             selectorRoot = null
802:             toast("Не удалось открыть выбор области")
803:         }
804:     }

812:     /** Рамка зафиксированной области: тонкие границы, клики — сквозь. */
813:     private fun applyFrame() {
814:         val show = prefs.overlayShowFrame().get() &&
815:             prefs.overlayRegionMode().get() == "fixed" &&
816:             parseRegion() != null
817:         frameVisibleState.value = show
818:         if (!show) {
819:             frameRoot?.let { runCatching { wm.removeView(it) } }
820:             frameRoot = null
821:             frameParams = null
822:             return
823:         }
824:         val region = parseRegion() ?: return
825:         val dm = resources.displayMetrics
826:         val x = (region.l * dm.widthPixels).toInt()
827:         val y = (region.t * dm.heightPixels).toInt()
828:         val w = ((region.r - region.l) * dm.widthPixels).toInt().coerceAtLeast(dp(24f))
829:         val h = ((region.b - region.t) * dm.heightPixels).toInt().coerceAtLeast(dp(24f))
830:         val thickness = dp(3f)
831:         val color = 0xFF4A7EAF.toInt()
832: 
833:         val box = FrameLayout(this)
834:         fun border(wPx: Int, hPx: Int, gravity: Int): View {
835:             val v = View(this)
836:             v.setBackgroundColor(color)
837:             box.addView(v, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(wPx, hPx, gravity))
838:             return v
839:         }
840:         border(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, thickness, Gravity.TOP)
841:         border(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, thickness, Gravity.BOTTOM)
842:         border(thickness, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, Gravity.START)
843:         border(thickness, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, Gravity.END)
844: 
845:         val existing = frameRoot
846:         if (existing != null && frameParams != null) {
847:             frameParams!!.x = x
848:             frameParams!!.y = y
849:             frameParams!!.width = w
850:             frameParams!!.height = h
851:             frameRoot = box
852:             runCatching {
853:                 wm.removeView(existing)
854:                 wm.addView(box, frameParams!!)
855:             }.onFailure {
856:                 frameRoot = null
857:                 frameParams = null
858:             }
859:             return
860:         }
861:         val p = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
862:             w,
863:             h,
864:             overlayType(),
865:             WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
866:                 WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE or
867:                 WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN,
868:             PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT,
869:         )
870:         p.gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
871:         p.x = x
872:         p.y = y
873:         frameRoot = box
874:         frameParams = p
875:         runCatching { wm.addView(box, p) }.onFailure {
876:             frameRoot = null
877:             frameParams = null
878:         }
879:     }

904:         // Панель рисуется тем же компонентом, что и плавающее меню читалки:

906:         // Compose внутри окна WindowManager требует владельцев жизненного
907:         // цикла — без них не работал бы rememberSaveable у поля ввода.
908:         val compose = ComposeView(this).apply {
909:             setViewTreeLifecycleOwner(panelLifecycleOwner)
910:             setViewTreeSavedStateRegistryOwner(panelSavedStateOwner)
911:             setViewTreeViewModelStoreOwner(panelViewModelOwner)

914:         layout.addView(

929:             PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT,
930:         )
931:         p.gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
932:         // Позиция сохраняется: раньше после перезапуска сервиса панель
933:         // возвращалась в точку (20, 140) dp и читатель её не находил.
934:         val positionPrefs = getSharedPreferences(POSITION_PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
935:         p.x = positionPrefs.getInt(KEY_POS_X, dp(20f))
936:         p.y = positionPrefs.getInt(KEY_POS_Y, dp(140f))
937:         params = p

939:         root = layout

941:             toast("Нет разрешения показывать поверх приложений")

71:         try {
72:             val pixels = IntArray(bmp.width * bmp.height)
73:             bmp.getPixels(pixels, 0, bmp.width, 0, 0, bmp.width, bmp.height)
74:             val image = OcrImage(bmp.width, bmp.height, pixels)
75:             // Движок передаётся явно: иначе распознавание всё равно ушло бы
76:             // в движок читалки, и переключатель «свой движок» ничего бы не
77:             // менял, кроме подписи на кнопке.
78:             Injekt.get<OcrRepository>()
79:                 .recognizeText(image, if (prefs.overlayOwnEngine().get()) engineModel() else null)
80:                 .trim()
81:                 .takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
82:         } catch (e: Exception) {
83:             Log.e(TAG, "overlay read failed", e)
84:             null
85:         } finally {
86:             if (!bmp.isRecycled) bmp.recycle()
87:         }
88:     }
89: 
90:     /**
91:      * Запускает цикл чтения.
92:      *
93:      * @param onPage сообщает, что распознан новый экран (для панели оверлея)
94:      * @param onNote сообщает, что делает цикл (для панели оверлея)
95:      * @return задача цикла — её отмена останавливает чтение
96:      */
97:     fun start(
98:         scope: CoroutineScope,
99:         region: Rect,
100:         onPage: (String) -> Unit = {},
101:         onNote: (String) -> Unit = {},
102:     ): Job = scope.launch {
103:         var lastText: String? = null
104:         var repeats = 0
105:         onNote("Чтение начато · ${engineTitle()}")
106: 
107:         // Служба доступности может подключиться позже, чем нажали «Читать»:
108:         // пока она выключена, листать нечем, и раньше цикл молча завершался
109:         // после первой реплики. Теперь ждём и продолжаем.
110:         if (!awaitGestureService(onNote)) return@launch
111: 
112:         while (isActive) {
113:             val text = readOnce(region)
114:             if (text == null) {
115:                 onNote("Не удалось прочитать кадр")
116:                 // Кадр может не успеть прогрузиться; ждать и пробовать
117:                 // снова вхолостую только жжёт батарею.
118:                 delay(RETRY_DELAY_MS)
119:                 continue
120:             }
121: 
122:             // Один и тот же текст после прокрутки означает, что приложение
123:             // не пролистнулось: озвучивать его второй раз бессмысленно, и
124:             // цикл ушёл бы в бесконечный повтор одного и того же.
125:             if (text == lastText) {
126:                 repeats++
127:                 if (repeats >= MAX_REPEATS) {
128:                     onNote("Приложение не пролистывается — листаю иначе")
129:                     // Последняя попытка: свайп длиннее и из другой точки.
130:                     // Некоторые приложения слушают жест только у самого низа
131:                     // экрана, и свайп по центру рамки они игнорируют.
132:                     if (!scrollWithFallback(region)) {
133:                         onNote("Прокрутка не идёт — проверьте Службу доступности")
134:                         return@launch
135:                     }
136:                     repeats = 0
137:                 }
138:             } else {
139:                 repeats = 0
140:                 lastText = text
141:                 onPage(text)
142:                 speakAndWait(text)
143:             }
144: 
145:             if (!scrollForward(region)) return@launch
146:             delay(settleAfterScrollMs)
147:         }
148:     }
149: 
150:     /**
151:      * Ждёт включения Службы доступности, пока её нет.
152:      *
153:      * Раньше цикл на первой же неудаче просто завершался, и читатель видел
154:      * одну озвученную реплику без прокрутки и без объяснения. Теперь при
155:      * выключенной службе чтение честно ждёт и говорит, что именно надо
156:      * включить, но ждёт не бесконечно: иначе кнопка «Стоп» пришлось бы искать
157:      * вслепую.
158:      *
159:      * @return false, если службу так и не включили либо чтение отменили
160:      */
161:     private suspend fun awaitGestureService(onNote: (String) -> Unit): Boolean {
162:         var waited = 0L
163:         // currentCoroutineContext(), а не isActive: здесь нет CoroutineScope,
164:         // и isActive без получателя просто не разрешается.
165:         while (currentCoroutineContext().isActive &&
166:             !OverlayGestureService.isEnabled() &&
167:             waited < GESTURE_WAIT_MAX_MS
168:         ) {
169:             if (waited == 0L) onNote("Включите Службу доступности — жду, чтобы листать")
170:             delay(GESTURE_WAIT_MS)
171:             waited += GESTURE_WAIT_MS
172:         }
173:         if (!OverlayGestureService.isEnabled()) {
174:             onNote("Без Службы доступности листать нечем — чтение остановлено")
175:             return false
176:         }
177:         return currentCoroutineContext().isActive
178:     }
179: 
180:     /**
181:      * Прокрутка вперёд с проверкой результата.
182:      *
183:      * Прежний код останавливал чтение на первом же отказе жеста, и читатель
184:      * слышал одну реплику — после неё не было ни прокрутки, ни объяснения.
185:      * Теперь отказ не завершает чтение: жест повторяется, а если и он не
186:      * прошёл, причина называется прямо.
187:      */
188:     private suspend fun scrollForward(region: Rect): Boolean {
189:         repeat(SCROLL_ATTEMPTS) {
190:             if (OverlayGestureService.swipeAndAwait(verticalSwipe(region, scrollDistance))) return true
191:             delay(SCROLL_RETRY_MS)
192:         }
193:         // Жест уходит, но экран не меняется: значит точка не слушается.
194:         return scrollWithFallback(region)
195:     }
196: 
197:     /** Свайп у самого низа рамки и длиннее обычного — последний довод. */
198:     private suspend fun scrollWithFallback(region: Rect): Boolean {
199:         val dy = (region.height() * FALLBACK_STEP).toInt()
200:         if (dy < 1) return false
201:         val x = region.left + (region.width() * FALLBACK_X).toInt()
202:         return OverlayGestureService.swipeAndAwait(
203:             fromX = x,
204:             fromY = region.bottom - (region.height() * 0.05f).toInt(),
205:             toX = x,
206:             toY = region.bottom - (region.height() * 0.05f).toInt() - dy,
207:             durationMs = FALLBACK_MS,
208:         )
209:     }
210: 
211:     /** Пара координат свайпа по центру области на долю [fraction] её высоты. */
212:     private fun verticalSwipe(region: Rect, fraction: Float): GestureSwipe {
213:         val dy = (region.height() * fraction).toInt()
214:         val cx = region.centerX()
215:         val cy = region.centerY()
216:         return GestureSwipe(cx, cy + dy, cx, cy - dy)
217:     }
218: 
219:     /**
220:      * Озвучивает и ждёт конца речи, затем паузу.
221:      *
222:      * `TtsSpeaker` не отдаёт «прочитано» промисом, но сообщает состояние
223:      * через колбэк: [onState] приходит false, когда речь закончилась.
224:      */
225:     private suspend fun speakAndWait(text: String) {
226:         val done = kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
227:         var started = false
228:         TtsSpeaker.speak(context, text) { speaking ->
229:             if (speaking) {
230:                 started = true
231:             } else if (started) {
232:                 done.complete(Unit)
233:             }
234:         }
235:         // Если движок не сообщил о начале (например, голос не найден),
236:         // ждать завершения бессмысленно — цикл обязан идти дальше.
237:         if (!started) {
238:             delay(NO_SPEECH_GRACE_MS)
239:             return
240:         }
241:         withTimeoutOrNull(MAX_SPEECH_MS) { done.await() }
242:         if (coroutineContext.isActive && pauseAfterSpeechMs > 0) delay(pauseAfterSpeechMs)
243:     }
244: 
245:     /**
246:      * Листать назад по одному экрану — кнопка «▲ назад» на панели.
247:      *
248:      * Работает и без запущенного цикла чтения: пригодится, чтобы вернуться к
249:      * предыдущей реплике вручную.
250:      */
251:     suspend fun scrollBack(region: Rect): Boolean {
252:         val dy = (region.height() * scrollDistance).toInt()
253:         if (dy < 1) return false
254:         val cx = region.centerX()
255:         val cy = region.centerY()
256:         return OverlayGestureService.swipeAndAwait(GestureSwipe(cx, cy - dy, cx, cy + dy))
257:     }
258: 
259:     companion object {
260:         private const val TAG = "OverlayAutoReader"
261:         private const val RETRY_DELAY_MS = 900L
262: 
263:         /** Сколько ждать, если движок вообще не начал говорить. */
264:         private const val NO_SPEECH_GRACE_MS = 300L
265: 
266:         /** Потолок одной реплики: иначе зависший движок стопорит цикл. */
267:         private const val MAX_SPEECH_MS = 5 * 60_000L
268: 
269:         /** Сколько одинаковых кадров подряд считаем «не пролисталось». */
270:         private const val MAX_REPEATS = 2
271: 
272:         /** Сколько раз повторить жест, прежде чем менять геометрию. */
273:         private const val SCROLL_ATTEMPTS = 2
274: 
275:         /** Пауза между попытками жеста, мс. */
276:         private const val SCROLL_RETRY_MS = 350L
277: 
278:         /** Как часто проверять, не включили ли Службу доступности, мс. */
279:         private const val GESTURE_WAIT_MS = 1_500L
280: 
281:         /** Сколько ждать включения Службы, прежде чем остановить чтение, мс. */
282:         private const val GESTURE_WAIT_MAX_MS = 90_000L
283: 
284:         /** Доля высоты области для запасного свайпа. */
285:         private const val FALLBACK_STEP = 0.7f
286: 
287:         /** Запасной свайп идёт левее центра: там меньше всего кнопок. */
288:         private const val FALLBACK_X = 0.35f
289: 
290:         /** Запасной свайп длиннее и медленнее — его замечают даже «вялые» списки. */
291:         private const val FALLBACK_MS = 480L
292:     }
293: }

25:  */
26: class OverlayCaptureEngine(
27:     context: Context,
28:     private val projection: android.media.projection.MediaProjection,
29: ) {
30:     private val appContext = context.applicationContext
31: 
32:     private var thread: HandlerThread? = null
33:     private var handler: Handler? = null
34:     private var reader: ImageReader? = null
35:     private var display: VirtualDisplay? = null
36:     private var sizeW: Int = 0
37:     private var sizeH: Int = 0
38:     private var density: Int = 0
39: 
40:     /** Размер захватываемого экрана в px (актуальны после первого capture). */
41:     var screenWidth: Int = 0
42:         private set
43:     var screenHeight: Int = 0
44:         private set
45: 
46:     /** Захватить текущий кадр и вернуть битмап области [rect] (в экранных px). */
47:     fun capture(rect: Rect): Bitmap? {
48:         if (display == null && !ensureStarted()) return null
49: 
50:         // Статичный экран может долго не порождать новых кадров (AUTO_MIRROR
51:         // отрисовывает только «грязные» области) — крутимся до 3 секунд.
52:         val succeedAt = System.currentTimeMillis() + 3000
53:         var image: android.media.Image? = null
54:         while (image == null && System.currentTimeMillis() < succeedAt) {
55:             image = reader?.acquireLatestImage()
56:             if (image == null) Thread.sleep(120)
57:         }
58:         val img = image ?: return null
59:         return try {
60:             val full = copyImage(img) ?: return null
61:             try {
62:                 val left = rect.left.coerceIn(0, full.width - 1)
63:                 val top = rect.top.coerceIn(0, full.height - 1)
64:                 val right = rect.right.coerceIn(left + 1, full.width)
65:                 val bottom = rect.bottom.coerceIn(top + 1, full.height)
66:                 Bitmap.createBitmap(full, left, top, right - left, bottom - top)
67:             } finally {
68:                 if (!full.isRecycled) full.recycle()
69:             }
70:         } finally {
71:             img.close()
72:         }
73:     }
74: 
75:     private fun ensureStarted(): Boolean {
76:         if (display != null && reader != null) return true
77:         // Предыдущая попытка могла упасть уже после создания ImageReader:
78:         // тогда reader остался не-null, а display — null, и ensureStarted()
79:         // больше никогда не доходил до createVirtualDisplay (захват умирал
80:         // навсегда). Перед повтором разбираем half-initialized состояние.
81:         releaseCaptureResources()
82: 
83:         val metrics = DisplayMetrics()
84:         @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
85:         (appContext.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager)
86:             .defaultDisplay
87:             .getRealMetrics(metrics)
88:         sizeW = metrics.widthPixels
89:         sizeH = metrics.heightPixels
90:         density = metrics.densityDpi
91:         screenWidth = sizeW
92:         screenHeight = sizeH
93:         if (sizeW <= 0 || sizeH <= 0) return false
94: 
95:         thread = HandlerThread("overlay_capture").also { it.start() }
96:         handler = Handler(thread!!.looper)
97:         reader = ImageReader.newInstance(sizeW, sizeH, PixelFormat.RGBA_8888, 2)
98:         display = try {
99:             projection.createVirtualDisplay(
100:                 "yomikai_overlay_capture",
101:                 sizeW,
102:                 sizeH,
103:                 density,
104:                 DisplayManager.VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_AUTO_MIRROR,
105:                 reader!!.surface,
106:                 null,
107:                 handler,
108:             )
109:         } catch (e: Exception) {
110:             Log.e("YomikaiOverlayCapture", "createVirtualDisplay failed", e)
111:             null
112:         }
113:         if (display == null) {
114:             // Чистим за собой, чтобы следующий capture() честно попробовал снова.
115:             releaseCaptureResources()
116:         }
117:         return display != null
118:     }
119: 
120:     /**
121:      * Гасит только собственные ресурсы захвата. MediaProjection не трогаем:
122:      * она принадлежит сервису, и её остановка погасила бы всю сессию.
123:      */
124:     private fun releaseCaptureResources() {
125:         runCatching { display?.release() }
126:         runCatching { reader?.close() }
127:         display = null
128:         reader = null
129:         handler?.looper?.quitSafely()
130:         thread?.join(500)
131:         thread = null
132:         handler = null
133:     }
134: 
135:     private fun copyImage(image: android.media.Image): Bitmap? {
136:         val plane = image.planes[0]
137:         val buffer = plane.buffer
138:         val pixelStride = plane.pixelStride
139:         val rowStride = plane.rowStride
140:         val rowPadding = rowStride - pixelStride * image.width
141:         if (rowPadding < 0) return null
142: 
143:         val aux = Bitmap.createBitmap(
144:             image.width + rowPadding / pixelStride,
145:             image.height,
146:             Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888,
147:         )
148:         aux.copyPixelsFromBuffer(buffer)
149:         val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(aux, 0, 0, image.width, image.height)
150:         if (!aux.isRecycled) aux.recycle()
151:         return bmp
152:     }
153: 
154:     fun stop() {
155:         releaseCaptureResources()
156:         runCatching { projection.stop() }
157:     }
158: }

    /**
     * Version code of the host application. May be useful for sharing as User-Agent information.
     * Note that this value differs between forks so logic should not rely on it.
     *
     * @since extension-lib 1.3
     */
    fun getVersionCode(): Int = BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE

    /**
     * Version name of the host application. May be useful for sharing as User-Agent information.
     * Note that this value differs between forks so logic should not rely on it.
     *
     * @since extension-lib 1.3
     */
    fun getVersionName(): String = BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME

    /**
     * A list of supported image MIME types by the reader.
     * e.g. ["image/jpeg", "image/png", ...]
     *
     * @since extension-lib 1.5
     */
    fun getSupportedImageMimeTypes(): List<String> = ImageUtil.ImageType.entries.map { it.mime }
}

private val panelSavedStateOwner = object : SavedStateRegistryOwner {
    private val registry = SavedStateRegistry.create(panelLifecycleOwner)

A scope that owns a `SavedStateRegistry`.

Pass this owner to create a `SavedStateRegistryController` through which the owner accesses and performs operations on its `SavedStateRegistry`.

The typical lifecycle flow and method call sequence of these components is:

```
Lifecycle.State                 SavedStateRegistryController---------------                 ----------------------------INITIALIZED ------------------> performAttach                                |                                performRestore                                |CREATED ------------------------+                                |STARTED ----------------------> (register providers, consume state)                                |CREATED ----------------------> performSave                                |DESTROYED <---------------------+
```

`SavedStateRegistryController.performAttach` must be called once (and only once) on the main thread during the owner's `Lifecycle.State.INITIALIZED` state. Call it before calling `SavedStateRegistryController.performRestore`.

`SavedStateRegistryController.performRestore` can be called with a nullable if nothing needs to be restored, or with the saved state to be restored. Call it in one of two places:

1. Directly before the `Lifecycle` moves to `Lifecycle.State.CREATED`.
2. Before `Lifecycle.State.STARTED` is reached, as part of the `LifecycleObserver` added during owner initialization.

`SavedStateRegistryController.performSave` should be called after the owner has been stopped but before it reaches `Lifecycle.State.DESTROYED` state. Call it only once the owner has received the `Lifecycle.Event.ON_STOP` event. The saved state passed to performSave will be the saved state restored by performRestore.

  прозрачная activity спрашивает разрешение и отдаёт его сервису.

  события не читает, узлы не обходит. По умолчанию выключена.
- OverlayAutoReader — цикл «кадр → OCR → озвучка → ожидание конца речи →
  свайп», остановка на одинаковом кадре (приложение не пролисталось).

Исправления по скриншотам:
- Авточтение озвучивало предложение и замолкало. Цикл останавливался на
  первом отказе жеста, а dispatchGesture возвращает лишь «жест отправлен»,
  не «сработал». Теперь ждём результат системы, повторяем жест, а если
  приложение его игнорирует — свайпаем длиннее и из другой точки.
  Пока Служба выключена, чтение ждёт и говорит, что включить, а не молчит.
- «Скриншот сохранён» → падение без ошибки. Фоновая задача получала битмап,
  который вызывающий переиспользовал сразу после возврата: getPixels по
  переиспользованному битмапу ронял процесс. Фону уходит своя копия.

  сервера валил весь разбор. Плюс coerceInputValues в общем Json.
- HTTP 500 → «0 глав»: временные отказы источника (5xx, 429, таймаут,
  обрыв) повторяются до трёх раз, и в snackbar есть «Повторить».

`ReaderFloatingControls.kt:133-136` — outer full-screen box, content aligned **BottomEnd**:

```kotlin
133:    Box(
134:        modifier = modifier.fillMaxSize(),
135:        contentAlignment = Alignment.BottomEnd,
136:    ) {
```

`:159-167` — the vertical column that holds both the menu card *and* the main button:

```kotlin
159:            Column(
160:                modifier = Modifier
161:                    .offset { IntOffset(offsetX.roundToInt(), offsetY.roundToInt()) }
164:                    .padding(start = 16.dp, end = 16.dp, top = 16.dp, bottom = 120.dp),
165:                horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End,
166:                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
167:            ) {
```

* **Vertical column, `horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End`** (right-aligned column, not centered). Items separated by 8.dp; bottom padding 120.dp keeps it above the reader bottom bar; whole column is user-draggable (`offsetX/offsetY`, clamped `x ∈ [-4000, 0]`, `y ∈ [-4000, 400]` px, `:505-511`).

`:169-186` — the menu card itself:

```kotlin
169:                AnimatedVisibility(
170:                    visible = menuOpen,
171:                    enter = fadeIn() + scaleIn(initialScale = 0.8f),
172:                    exit  = fadeOut() + scaleOut(targetScale = 0.8f),
173:                ) {
174:                    Card(
175:                        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(
176:                            containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.96f),
177:                        ),
178:                    ) {
179:                        Column(
180:                            modifier = Modifier
181:                                .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
182:                                .heightIn(max = 480.dp)
183:                                .padding(10.dp),
184:                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
185:                            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End,
186:                        ) {
```

* **Background alpha:** `surfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.96f)` — nearly opaque dark panel.
* **Rounded corners:** M3 `Card` default shape = `RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)` (no explicit shape passed).
* **Width:** **no `width()`/`fillMaxWidth()` anywhere** → the card is *wrap-content*: its width equals the widest row (see §2).
* **Max height + scroll:** yes — `heightIn(max = 480.dp)` **plus** `verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())`, 10.dp inner padding, 6.dp row gap. With ~14–18 rows the column normally exceeds 480 dp and is scrollable, so the "bottom" of the menu in a screenshot is scroll-position dependent.
* Visibility gate: `ReaderActivity.kt:1047` → `visible = state.menuVisible && state.dialog == null`.

---

## 2. Row layout (why labels sit at different x)

Every row is the same shape: **`Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically)` with NO `fillMaxWidth()`**, containing a `Text(labelMedium)` then one (or two) `SmallFloatingActionButton`s. Example `:189-200`:

```kotlin
189:                                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
190:                                    Text("OCR скан  ", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium)
191:                                    SmallFloatingActionButton(onClick = { … onTriggerOcr() }) {
198:                                        Icon(Icons.Outlined.DocumentScanner, contentDescription = "OCR")
```

Full row inventory (line = start of `Row`):

| Lines | Label | Action (M3 `SmallFloatingActionButton`, 40.dp circle) |
|---|---|---|
| 189-200 (guard 187 `r_scan`) | `"OCR скан  "` | `DocumentScanner` → `onTriggerOcr` |
| 205-225 (guard 203 `r_autoscroll`) | `"Стоп прокрутки  "` / `"Автопрокрутка  "` | `Pause`/`PlayArrow`, tint `primary` when active |
| 228-242 (conditional) | `Speed` icon + `Slider(width140.dp)` + `"×N"` | autoscroll speed, only when autoscroll is on |
| 245-272 (guard 243 `r_autoread`) | `"Чтение: идёт…  "` / `"Прочитать страницу  "` | `GraphicEq`/`PlayArrow`, `secondaryContainer`/`tertiaryContainer`; sets `menuOpen = false` |
| 275-298 | `"Стоп чтения  "` | `StopCircle`/`Pause`, `errorContainer` when reading |
| 301-309 (guard 299 `r_instant_sc`) | `"Скриншот сейчас  "` | `CameraAlt` → `onInstantScreenshot` |
| 314-333 (guard 312 `r_voiceicons`) | `"Значки озвучки: вкл  "` / `": выкл  "` | `RecordVoiceOver`, tint `primary` when on |
| 338-371 (guard 336 `r_order`) | `"$presetTitle · $presetOrder  "` → `"Манхва · ↓ Сверху вниз  "` | `DocumentScanner`, cycles manga→manhwa→manhua→comic |
| 374-383 | `"AI-чат  "` | `SmartToy`; sets `menuOpen = false`, opens chat overlay |
| 388-421 | `"Голос: вручную  "` / `"Голос: авто  "` | **two** buttons: `TouchApp`/`AutoMode` + `Spacer(8.dp)` + the `♂`/`♀` button |
| 425-434 (guard 423 `r_tts`) | `"Озвучка (TTS)  "` | `RecordVoiceOver` → TTS dialog |
| 439-448 (guard 437 `r_ocr_bubbles`) | `"Настройки OCR (баблы)  "` | `Tune` → full OCR settings |
| 451-459 / 460-468 | `"Мужской голос  "` / `"Женский голос  "` | writes `voicePresetGender()` pref + toast |
| 469-491 (conditional) | `"Кнопки конструктора  "` | `IconButton` expand arrow + one row per user `UiAction` |
| 492-496 | `"yomikai <version>"` | plain `labelSmall` text, no button |

**Icon right, text left.** Because the `Row` wraps content and the inner `Column` uses `horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End`:

* every row's **right edge is identical** (button right edge = card right − 10.dp padding);
* the label is the first, flexible-length child, so the **label's left edge = row right edge − label width − 40.dp**;
* → short labels (`"OCR скан"`, `"AI-чат"`) start far to the **right**; long labels (`"Значки озвучки: вкл"`, `"Манхва · ↓ Сверху вниз"`, `"Настройки OCR (баблы)"`) start far to the **left**. That ragged-left / common-right-edge look in a screenshot is *not* centering — there is no `textAlign` and no `Arrangement.Center` anywhere.
* labels never wrap (`labelMedium`, no `maxLines`, no `width`), so a long label simply makes that row — and therefore **the whole card** — wider; short rows leave empty space on the left inside the card.
* every label string carries **two trailing spaces** (`"OCR скан  "`), so the text/button gap is fixed for all rows.
* exception that breaks right-edge alignment: the "Голос" row (388-421) has `Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))` **plus a second 40.dp button**, so its rightmost control sits ~48.dp further right than every other row's button.

---

## 3. The large light-blue "X" on top of the rows

It is **the reader's own main FAB (menu toggle), in the same file** — `ReaderFloatingControls.kt:502-525`:

```kotlin
502:                // Главная кнопка: тап — меню; перетаскивание — отдельная
503:                // обёртка Box поверх FAB, чтобы клик и drag не конфликтовали.
504:                Box(
505:                    modifier = Modifier.pointerInput(Unit) {
506:                        detectDragGestures { change, dragAmount ->
507:                            change.consume()
508:                            offsetX = (offsetX + dragAmount.x).coerceIn(-4000f, 0f)
509:                            offsetY = (offsetY + dragAmount.y).coerceIn(-4000f, 400f)
510:                        }
511:                    },
512:                ) {
513:                    FloatingActionButton(
514:                        onClick = { beepOpen(); menuOpen = !menuOpen },
518:                        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
519:                    ) {
520:                        Icon(
521:                            if (menuOpen) Icons.Outlined.Close else Icons.Outlined.Menu,
522:                            contentDescription = "Меню читалки",
523:                        )
524:                    }
525:                }
```

* **What it is:** *not* a drag handle (the drag gesture lives on the invisible wrapper `Box`,504-512), *not* a collapse/close control, *not* the reader FAB from `ReaderAppBars`. It is the SAO-style **main reader FAB whose icon flips to `Icons.Outlined.Close` when the menu is expanded**.
* **Size:** stock M3 `FloatingActionButton` = **56.dp** box (M3 default `shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)`), *not* ~100.dp — under `MaterialExpressiveTheme` (`TachiyomiTheme.kt:59`) it is still 56.dp, which is why it reads as a **rounded square rather than a circle**. (If your screenshot really shows ~96–100.dp, that is `LargeFloatingActionButton`, which is not used here — please re-check the px/dp assumption.)
* **Color:** `colorScheme.primary`. In the default dark scheme that is **`#B0C6FF` (light blue)** with `onPrimary = #002D6E` (dark navy X) — `TachiyomiColorScheme.kt:20-21`. Exactly the "light blue rounded square with a dark X" you describe.
* **Placement / z-order:** it is the **second child of the same right-aligned `Column`** (after the `AnimatedVisibility(Card)`), so: measured **below** the card, separated by `spacedBy(8.dp)`, `horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End` → its **right edge coincides with the card's right edge**. Because it is the later sibling it is **painted after (on top of)** the card and carries the FAB elevation/shadow.
* **Is the overlap intended? No.** Layout-wise it cannot overlap:8.dp gap, same right edge, and any drag offset is applied to the whole `Column` (161) so card and FAB always move together. What *is* by design: the FAB is 56.dp wide vs. the 40.dp row buttons and the card's 10.dp inner padding, so the FAB's left edge juts ~6.dp left of the row buttons while its shadow/box draws over anything of the card it touches. A mid-animation capture (`scaleIn(initialScale = 0.8f)`, line 171) can also make the card's bottom rows sit visually against the FAB.
* There is **no** separate close button anywhere in the reader: the only other `Icons.Outlined.Close` in reader code is the AI-chat header `IconButton` (`ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:407-409`, 48.dp `IconButton`, no container) and the OCR result card's `IconButton` (`OcrResultOverlay.kt:231-233`). `ReaderBottomBar.kt` has no close/collapse button at all.

---

## 4. Unlabeled round button with the ♀ glyph

`ReaderFloatingControls.kt:406-420` — the **voice-gender toggle**, second control on the "Голос: авто" row:

```kotlin
406:                                    SmallFloatingActionButton(
407:                                        onClick = {
408:                                            if (!manualVoice) return@SmallFloatingActionButton
410:                                            voiceGender = if (voiceGender == "male") "female" else "male"
411:                                            onVoiceGenderChange(voiceGender)
412:                                        },
413:                                        containerColor = if (manualVoice) {
414:                                            MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer
415:                                        } else {
416:                                            MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant
417:                                        },
418:                                    ) {
419:                                        Text(if (voiceGender == "male") "♂" else "♀")
420:                                    }
```

* **Action:** toggles the manual TTS voice gender (`♀` ⇄ `♂`) → `onVoiceGenderChange` → `ReaderActivity.kt:1056-1060` writes `ocrPrefs.manualVoiceGender()` + toast.
* **No label because** it is the only control in the menu whose content is a raw `Text("♀"/"♂")` glyph inside a 40.dp round `SmallFloatingActionButton` — it has **no `Text` caption, no `Icon`, and no `contentDescription`**, so it is unlabeled both visually and for accessibility/TalkBack (unlike every neighbour, which at least has a `contentDescription`). It is also the widest row (label + 40 + 8 + 40 dp), which is why it sticks out to the right of the button column.
* It is guarded by nothing, but is **inert unless `manualVoice` is true** (`if (!manualVoice) return@SmallFloatingActionButton`, line 408) and greyed out (`surfaceVariant`) in auto mode — matching the screenshot label `"Голос: авто"` next to a dim `♀`.
* It appears near the bottom of the visible menu because the card is capped at `heightIn(max = 480.dp)` + `verticalScroll` (181-182); the exact bottom visible row depends on scroll state.
* (The other `♀` in the reader, `TranslationCard.kt:186-189`, is a plain 48.dp `IconButton` with no circular container inside the translation card — not the button you're seeing.)

---

## 5. Same component or two independent ones?

**Same component, same file.** The menu card, the `♀` button and the light-blue "X" are all children of the one `Column` inside `ReaderFloatingControls` (`:159-167`):

```
Box(fillMaxSize, contentAlignment = BottomEnd)          :133-136
├─ ScanHourglassStateIcon  .align(TopEnd)               :143-153   (OCR busy indicator, unrelated)
└─ AnimatedVisibility(visible) :154-158 └─ Column(offset = drag, padding 16/16/16/120,       :159-167
   │          horizontalAlignment = End, spacedBy 8.dp)
      ├─ AnimatedVisibility(menuOpen) → Card            :169-499   ← the labels
      │    └─ Column(verticalScroll, heightIn(max=480.dp),
      │              padding 10.dp, spacedBy 6.dp,
      │              horizontalAlignment = End)
      │       └─ Row(...) x N :189-496  (label left + SmallFAB right)
      └─ Box(detectDragGestures)                         :504-512   ← drag wrapper
         └─ FloatingActionButton(primary, Close/Menu)    :513-524   ← the "X"
```

There is no second/parallel implementation: no other file in either repo draws these labels, and `ReaderFloatingControls` has exactly one call site (`ReaderActivity.kt:1046`), placed *after* `ReaderAppBars` (`:940`) and *before* `OcrSelectionOverlay` (`:1114`). Relative geometry is purely the Column's right alignment: the X sits 8.dp **below** the card, right edges flush, 56.dp wide (vs. 40.dp row buttons) — so it is drawn over/next to the card's lower-right corner, but it is a **sibling toggle button, not an overlay on the menu**.
</task_result>
</task>

Answer: Yes. Plan:

Architecture: extract the reader's menu into a shared composable (e.g. `OcrControlPanel`) that both:
1. The reader uses inline (as today, `ReaderFloatingControls`).
2. The overlay service uses — but here's the key problem: the overlay is a **View-based WindowManager** overlay (`OcrOverlayService.kt`), and Compose in a Service requires a `ComposeView` in the window (possible: `ComposeView(this).apply { setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnDetachedFromWindow) }` added to the WindowManager view tree). Compose can run in a Service window — it works but needs a `LifecycleOwner` and `SavedStateRegistryOwner` for `rememberSaveable`; can use `ViewTreeLifecycleOwner.set(...)` or a simple `LifecycleRegistry`. Doable.

So the plan:
- One shared composable `OcrControlMenu` with a state/回调 model (`OcrMenuState` + `OcrMenuActions`) so both hosts drive it.
- Reader host: existing state, in-app.
- Overlay host: `ComposeView` inside the WindowManager window, with actions routed to the existing service methods (startReading/stopReading, region selector, engine pick, STT, clipboard/dictionary, settings).

Improvements needed for the over-all-apps case (things the reader UI can't do or does differently):

13:        tools:ignore="ScopedStorage" />

- `data/ai/RunnerLlm.kt:359` — `File.createTempFile("yomi_video_", ".mp4")`.

---

## 5. Ranked list of why the file is invisible in the file manager

**#1 — Destination is app-private internal storage (≈95% of the cause).**
`OcrScreenshotBuffer.kt:56–57` → `File(context.filesDir, "screenshots_images")`; write at `:86`. `/data/data/<pkg>/files/` is not exposed to any other app, is not scanned by `MediaProvider`, and cannot be reached by Данные/Файлы/Gallery. No MediaStore row is ever created, so no `Pictures/`, no `DCIM/`, no `Download/`.
Supporting evidence: `docs/ocr-releases/2026-09-24-v1.9.92.md:15` and `todo.md:116` name `filesDir/screenshots_images` explicitly; `OcrScreenshotEntry.kt:42` and the Screenshots UI read it back with `File(...)`/`AsyncImage` — there is no `content://` URI anywhere; grep shows `MediaStore` used only by `ImageSaver.kt` and `AiWorkspace.kt`.

**#2 — The "Скриншот сохранён" toast is unconditional, so a total silent no-op looks like success (≈50% likelihood of *also* contributing).**
`ReaderActivity.kt:1949` fires the toast right after a `Unit`-returning call. The engine can return without writing anything at `AutoReadEngine.kt:810` (pref `pref_auto_screenshot` off, default `true` per `OcrPreferences.kt:493`, but user-toggleable at `SettingsConstructorScreen.kt:196`), `:811` (recycled bitmap), `:820` (copy failed), `:831` (25 s OCR timeout, `OCR_FRAME_TIMEOUT_MS` at `:1602`), or `:837` (empty regions). User sees "Скриншот сохранён", nothing exists anywhere.

**#3 — JPEG is encoded and then thrown away when OCR returns no regions.**
`AutoReadEngine.kt:834` encodes the JPEG, `:837` `if (result.regions.isEmpty()) return@launch`. The `OcrScreenshotBuffer.add` at `:847` is never reached. The image bytes exist only in a local `ByteArray` for the duration of one coroutine — **never persisted**. Ordering bug: the emptiness check sits *after* the encode and *before* the add.

**#4 — Text-only entry: `imageJpeg` null → no image file, silently.**
`OcrScreenshotBuffer.kt:84` `imageJpeg?.let { … }`. If `encodeJpeg` throws (OOM on a 1600 px ARGB bitmap, recycled source), `.getOrNull()` at `AutoReadEngine.kt:834` yields `null`, the entry is still added, `imagePath` is `null` (`OcrScreenshotEntry.kt:42`), and `ScreenshotTab.kt:186` / `ScreenshotDetailScreen.kt:152` fall back to a *synthetic grid placeholder*. From the user's side there is "a screenshot record but no picture".

**#5 — `imagesDir` is `null` (or its `mkdirs()` failed) → same text-only outcome.**
`OcrScreenshotBuffer.kt:85` `imagesDir?.let { … }`. `imagesDir` is set only in `init()` (`:53–59`), called from `App.kt:168`. If `init()` were skipped or `mkdirs()` returned false, `add()` silently produces `imagePath = null`. (In the normal build `App.kt:168` does run on the main thread in `onCreate`, so this is unlikely — but it is a silent-by-design failure mode with no log line.)

**#6 — Eviction deletes the file (and the user's expectation of permanence).**
`OcrScreenshotBuffer.kt:104–109`: the ring buffer defaults to 50 entries (`:31`, `App.kt:170–171` reads `pref_screenshot_buffer_size`, also `:106–107` in `todo.md`) and the oldest entry **and its JPEG** are deleted on every overflow (`:154–160` `deleteImageFile`). Autoread can add an entry per page, so a screenshot can be deleted within minutes. Compounded by `clear()` (`:126–131`) and `clearChapter()` (`:134–140`).

**#7 — `WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` is declared without `maxSdkVersion="28"` and is a no-op on API 29+.**
`AndroidManifest.xml:11–13`. On API 29+ it grants nothing (API 30+ it is never granted at all); there is no `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES`. Combined with `requestLegacyExternalStorage`/`preserveLegacyExternalStorage` (lines 81–82) being ignored at `targetSdk 36` (`gradle/mihon.versions.toml:5`), there is *no* permission/tooling in place for any future direct-to-public-dir write. This is not the cause today (nothing tries to write publicly), but it means the fix must be MediaStore-based, not `File`-based.

**#8 — Not relevant / ruled out.** No `ChapterOcrTranscript` involvement (`ui/manga/MangaScreenModel.kt:853–854` writes text/markdown only). No Room/SQLDelight table for screenshots exists (zero `.sq` hits for "screenshot"); persistence is a hand-rolled JSON file (`OcrScreenshotBuffer.kt:32, 39, 162–186`). No `.nomedia` / `MediaScannerConnection` suppression is in play — the file is simply never published at all.

---

## 6. What is missing / wrong (precise, no patch)

1. **There is no public-storage write for the instant screenshot at all.** `AutoReadEngine.captureInstantScreenshot` (`AutoReadEngine.kt:804–873`) ends at `OcrScreenshotBuffer.add(...)` (`:847`), whose only file write is `OcrScreenshotBuffer.kt:86` `File(imagesDir, "$id.jpg").writeBytes(jpeg)` with `imagesDir = File(context.filesDir, …)` (`:57`). There is no `MediaStore.Images` insert, no `RELATIVE_PATH = Environment.DIRECTORY_PICTURES + "/Yomikai"`, no `DISPLAY_NAME`, no `MIME_TYPE`, no `IS_PENDING` clear, no `DiskUtil.scanMedia(...)`.
2. **The app already owns a correct implementation it doesn't use here:** `eu.kanade.tachiyomi.data.saver.ImageSaver.saveApi29` (`ImageSaver.kt:62–112`) — `MediaStore.Images.Media.getContentUri(VOLUME_EXTERNAL_PRIMARY)`, `RELATIVE_PATH = Pictures/<app_name>/<relativePath>`, `MIME_TYPE`, `DATE_MODIFIED`, `openOutputStream`, then `DiskUtil.scanMedia` (`:109`). It is wired only to `ReaderViewModel.saveImage` (`:1216`) and `MangaCoverScreenModel` (`:105–108`).
3. **The success toast lies.** `ReaderActivity.kt:1949` is emitted after a `Unit` call with four silent bail-outs upstream (`:810, :811, :820, :831`) plus the post-encode discard at `:837`.
4. **`AutoReadEngine.kt:834` vs `:837`** — the JPEG is produced before the `result.regions.isEmpty()` guard, so a successful capture with no OCR text is thrown away entirely.
5. **Silent degrade instead of fail:** `OcrScreenshotBuffer.kt:84–88` returns `imagePath = null` for a null JPEG or null `imagesDir` with no log and no error; `ScreenshotTab.kt:186` / `ScreenshotDetailScreen.kt:152` then render a grid placeholder.
6. **No escape hatch:** the Screenshots UI has no export/share, and `app/src/main/res/xml/provider_paths.xml` declares `<files-path name="files_ai_workspace" path="ai_workspace/" />` only — `screenshots_images/` is outside every configured FileProvider root, so even an added share button would fail.
7. **Manifest gap for a real fix:** `AndroidManifest.xml:11–13` should carry `android:maxSdkVersion="28"` on `WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` (and/or `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES` for the ≥33 split) — though with a MediaStore write no runtime permission is needed at all.
8. **Overlay path is a separate, more severe hole:** `OverlayCaptureEngine.capture()` (`OverlayCaptureEngine.kt:47–73`) → `OverlayAutoReader.readOnce()` (`OverlayAutoReader.kt:69–88`) recycles the frame at `:86`; no persistence, and `OcrOverlayService`'s `AutoReadEngine` (`:205`) never calls `readFrame`. There is no instant-screenshot affordance in the overlay UI to hang a fix on.

**Consumption (playback) — `TtsSpeaker.kt`:**

* `speakAs(context, text, gender, speakerSlot, onState)` — `TtsSpeaker.kt:541-592`. The single entry point.
  * `TtsSpeaker.kt:566` `effectiveGender = manual ?: gender ?: SpeechMarkup.genderOf(text)`
  * `TtsSpeaker.kt:567` `val slot = if (speakerSlot != 0) speakerSlot else SpeechMarkup.speakerSlot(text)`
  * `TtsSpeaker.kt:570` `val speakerName = SpeechMarkup.speakerName(text)`
* `TtsSpeaker.kt:583-591` — engine fan-out:
```kotlin
when (effective) {
    ENGINE_GOOGLE_WEB -> speakGoogleWeb(context, spoken)          // gender+slot+role DROPPED
    ENGINE_EDGE_TTS   -> speakEdgeTts(context, spoken)            // gender+slot+role DROPPED
    ENGINE_ELEVENLABS -> speakElevenLabs(context, spoken)         // gender+slot+role DROPPED
    ENGINE_REMOTE, "onnx_tts", "onnx" -> speakRemote(context, spoken, effectiveGender)  // slot+role DROPPED
    else -> speakSystem(context, spoken, effectiveGender, slot, speakerName)  // full path
}
```
* `VoiceRoleDictionary.resolve` is called **only** at `TtsSpeaker.kt:652` (inside `speakSystem`) and `TtsSpeaker.kt:326` (`slotVoiceSpec`, used only by `speakRole` from the manual ♀/♂ buttons).
* `VoiceIntonationDictionary.matchRule` is called **only** at `TtsSpeaker.kt:811` (inside `speakSystem`).

**Chapter transcript — `ChapterOcrTranscript.kt`:**

```kotlin

// ChapterOcrTranscript.kt:41-60  build()

### A.2 The AI agent's reading path

`AiAgent.SYSTEM_PROMPT` (`AiAgent.kt:216-227`) documents exactly one speaking route:

```
"@tool reader_do {\"action\":\"speak_page\"} — выполнить действие читалки: " +
"speak_page (озвучить текущую страницу), speak_chapter (озвучивать всю главу), " +
"stop_speak (прекратить озвучку), page_text (распознать текст текущей страницы), " +
"see_page (СПРОСИТЬ ВИЖУЩУЮ МОДЕЛЬ про открытую в читалке страницу книги, " +
"обязательно с вопросом: {\"action\":\"see_page\",\"question\":\"что нарисовано на этой странице?\"} — " +
"это твои глаза на КНИГУ, веб-страницу так не посмотреть), " +
"page_count (сколько страниц в главе), " +
"turn_page (ЛИСТАТЬ САМ: {\"action\":\"turn_page\",\"to\":\"next|prev|first|last\"}), " +
"auto_read ({\"action\":\"auto_read\",\"to\":\"on|off\"} — самому включить или выключить авточтение и читать главу)\n"
```

Dispatch chain (verified):

```
AiAgent.kt:1377-1380   @tool speak_page / speak_chapter / auto_read …  (READER_ACTION_ALIASES, AiAgent.kt:708-711)
   └─> ReaderAiActions.run() ReaderAiActions.kt:39-50  (120 s timeout, but…)
ReaderActivity.kt:1617-1620  register("reader.speak_page")  → withUIContext { autoSpeakVisiblePage() }; return "Озвучиваю текущую страницу"
ReaderActivity.kt:1621-1624  register("reader.speak_chapter") → startAutoReadLoop()
ReaderActivity.kt:1638-1643  register("reader.auto_read")    → setAutoRead()
ReaderActivity.kt:1608-1612  autoSpeakVisiblePage() → stopAutoReadLoop(); clearHistory(); readCurrentPage(thenAdvance=false)
ReaderActivity.kt:1698-1705  startAutoReadLoop()   → readCurrentPage(thenAdvance=true)
ReaderActivity.kt:1778-1854  readCurrentPage() → autoReadEngine.readFrame(...)
AutoReadEngine.kt:312-791 readFrame → speakAndAwait → TtsSpeaker.speakAs
```

**Answer:** the agent has **no dedicated TTS/speak tool of its own**. It reaches the *identical* `AutoReadEngine.readFrame` pipeline a human tap does. Therefore:
* It **does** go through the per-frame gender + speaker-slot logic — it is not a separate "single default voice" path.
* It has **no way to pass an explicit voice/role** — `ReaderAiActions.register` handlers take no voice argument, and `reader_do` accepts only `action` + a couple of scalars.
* The other speaking-adjacent tool, `render_audio` (`AiChatTools.kt:23`, executed `AiAgent.kt:951-967`), is **not** the reading path: it synthesises an arbitrary *text string* the model supplies into one MP3 with one Edge voice (`AiChatTools.kt:101-132`). It cannot read a page.
* `voice_preview` (`AiChatTools.kt:81-85`) only plays a fixed test phrase.

### A.3 Root causes of "all voices at once"

There is **no** code that fires several voices simultaneously. I verified:

* Tool execution is strictly sequential — `AiAgent.kt:591` `val outputs = calls.map { call -> … execute(…) … }` on a `List` (eager, ordered). No `async`, no `awaitAll`, no `launch` fan-out.
* There is **no batch-speak tool**. `speakAndAwait` (`AutoReadEngine.kt:1076-1146`) is a hard barrier per bubble: phase 1 waits for TTS start (`TTS_START_GRACE_MS`), phase 2 polls until `done` or `ttsTimeoutMs`. The whole per-bubble loop at `AutoReadEngine.kt:667-772` is a sequential `for`.
* `TtsSpeaker` is a singleton with one `systemTts` and one `mediaPlayer` field (`TtsSpeaker.kt:96`), and `stop()` cancels `currentJob` (`TtsSpeaker.kt:594-604`), so overlapping calls clobber rather than layer.

So the symptom is **wrong behaviour from three separate defects**, not literal parallelism:

**(1) `VoiceRoleDictionary` / `VoiceIntonationDictionary` are unreachable from OCR auto-read.** They key off `SpeechMarkup.speakerName(text)`, i.e. `{имя:Аки}` markup (`SpeechMarkup.kt:70-80`). `AutoReadEngine` only ever builds `{N}` and `{ж}`/`{м}` (`AutoReadEngine.kt:717-723`) — bubble text comes from OCR and has no speaker name. So `speakerName` is always `null` at `TtsSpeaker.kt:570`, and `VoiceRoleDictionary.resolve(prefs(), null, gender)` (`TtsSpeaker.kt:652`) degrades to a **gender-only** match. The user's carefully configured per-character roles are silently ignored during reading. ⇒ **Wrong behaviour (silent feature bypass), not a missing feature.**

**(2) The "per-character" slot is keyed by gender, not by character.** `AutoReadEngine.kt:119` `private val speakerSlots = mutableMapOf<String, Int>()` — keyed by the gender string. `voiceSlotFor` (`AutoReadEngine.kt:137-151`) increments the slot on *every* new line that isn't a fuzzy match against the previous frame:
```kotlin
val next = if (continuesPrev) current else current + 1
speakerSlots[key] = next
```
For `[A♀, B♀, A♀, B♀]` on one page the slots go `0, 1, 2, 3`; `VoiceHelper.pickForSpeaker` then does `pool[(offset + speakerSlot) % pool.size]` (`VoiceHelper.kt:363`). **The same character is assigned a different voice partway through one scene**, and on a device with ≥4 Russian voices every bubble sounds like a different speaker. This is the most likely mechanical explanation of "all voices at once". ⇒ **Buggy.**

**(3) The streaming pass drops gender and slot entirely.** `AutoReadEngine.kt:1024`:
```kotlin
return when (speakAndAwait(text, gender = null)) {   // speakerSlot defaults to 0
```
For `ltr`/`vertical` reading orders (`orderAllowsStreaming`, `AutoReadEngine.kt:1073`) the *first* bubbles of every frame are spoken with `gender = null, slot = 0` → `TtsSpeaker.kt:718` `presetVoice.isNotBlank() && speakerSlot == 0` → the single narrator/primary voice. Only the tail of the frame gets real roles. Result: the voice changes mid-page, back and forth. ⇒ **Buggy.**

**(4) Engines silently discard role information.** For `edge_tts` / `google_web` / `eleven_labs` the per-bubble `gender`, `slot` and `speakerName` are dropped at `TtsSpeaker.kt:583-588`; for `remote_tts` only `gender` survives (`TtsSpeaker.kt:589`). Since `AiChatTools` pushes `edgeVoice` (`AiChatTools.kt:94`) and `edgeVoice` is the AI-chat-oriented engine, an AI-triggered read frequently uses **one voice for the whole chapter**. ⇒ **Buggy / feature gap.**

**(5) `manualVoiceMode` short-circuits everything.** `AutoReadEngine.kt:708-709` — if the reader has ever tapped a ♀/♂/🎙 button, `gender` becomes a constant for the whole chapter and the per-frame role logic at706-712 is skipped. ⇒ Expected-by-design, but it is the usual explanation for "one voice for all".

### A.4 The barrier question (fire-and-forget?)

| Path | Barrier? |
|---|---|
| `AutoReadEngine.readFrame` bubble loop | **Yes** — `speakAndAwait` (`AutoReadEngine.kt:1076-1146`) |
| Page advance (`onPageFinished`) | **Yes** — `AutoReadEngine.kt:786-788` only after all bubbles |
| `speak_chapter` / `auto_read on` | **Yes** — loop is driven by `onPageFinished` (`ReaderActivity.kt:1825-1848`) |
| **`reader_do speak_page` as seen by the LLM** | **NO — fire and forget** |

```kotlin
// ReaderActivity.kt:1617-1620
actions.register("${READER_ACTION_PREFIX}speak_page") {
    withUIContext { autoSpeakVisiblePage() }     // readCurrentPage() → lifecycleScope.launchIO { … }
    "Озвучиваю текущую страницу"                  // returns immediately
}
```
`readCurrentPage` launches `lifecycleScope.launchIO { … }` (`ReaderActivity.kt:1780`) and returns at once, so `ReaderAiActions.run` (`ReaderAiActions.kt:39`) resolves in milliseconds while TTS is still speaking. There is **no "wait until TTS finishes" tool result and no `is_speaking` / `wait_idle` tool.** Consequences:

* If the model emits `speak_page` and then, in the next round (or the same round after `turn_page`), another `speak_page`/`turn_page`, the new `readFrame` runs `job?.cancel(); TtsSpeaker.stop()` (`AutoReadEngine.kt:319-320`) and the previous utterance is cut off mid-word. The agent literally cannot read page-by-page and know when a page is done.
* Within one round, `AiAgent.kt:534` dedups by `callSignature`, so two identical `@tool speak_page {}` in one message collapse to one — the model cannot even queue 5 sequential page reads in one reply.
* Note `speak_chapter` and `auto_read on` are **equivalent** (`ReaderActivity.kt:1621-1624` → `startAutoReadLoop`; `ReaderActivity.kt:1764-1768` → `startAutoReadLoop`). This is why "read the book" always becomes auto-read (§B).

### B.4 Prompt text that biases toward auto-read and toward image generation

2. `speak_chapter` and `auto_read on` are the same code (`ReaderActivity.kt:1621` / `1764-1768`), and both are described in *speech* terms only ("озвучивать всю главу"). A model asked to "read the book" picks the only whole-book verb it has.
3. `AiAgent.kt:289-291` reinforces TTS troubleshooting as a first-class flow:
   `"Если пользователь жалуется на озвучку/голоса/синтез (молчит, один голос на всех ролей, движок «исчез» из списка) — ПЕРВЫМ вызывай tts_status…"`

```

```

### B.5 `RunnerLlm.kt` — worth flagging

`RunnerLlm` is **not** a tool-calling agent. It is a GitHub-Actions GGUF/llama.cpp host (`RunnerLlm.kt:118-215`, `239-315`, `749-835`). Its `chat()` (`RunnerLlm.kt:641-683`) sends a bare `messages` array with **no system prompt and no tool list** and never returns tool calls. It is reachable from the agent only as the `runner_chat` *tool* (`AiAgent.kt:1001-1017`) and as an alternate `chatFn` backend (`AiBackends.kt:75-77`, wired at `ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:848-860`). Therefore:
* `runner_chat` (the tool) can never read, speak, screenshot, or write files — it is a plain LLM round-trip whose output is pasted to the user as tool text.
* When `RunnerLlm` is selected as the *orchestrator backend*, the model still receives `AiAgent.SYSTEM_PROMPT` (it's passed as `systemPromptEffective`), so tools work — but a 0.5B–1.5B GGUF is what then chooses between `gen_image` and `page_text`.
